en.title: Hideo Kojima's 'Physint' Jumps to Xbox After PlayStation Cancellation
en.summary: In a seismic shift for the gaming world, Hideo Kojima's highly anticipated action-espionage title, 'Physint,' has found a new home with Xbox. The move follows a surprising decision by PlayStation to cancel the project.
en.body:
The legendary **Hideo Kojima**, the visionary behind **Metal Gear** and **Death Stranding**, is bringing his next major project, **Physint**, under the Xbox umbrella. This significant change in publishing partners comes after Sony's PlayStation reportedly canceled the action-espionage game, prompting Kojima Productions to seek new avenues. The news signifies a major win for Microsoft's gaming division, securing an exclusive title from one of the industry's most distinctive voices.

**Physint**, a project that has been generating considerable buzz among fans eager for Kojima's unique brand of cinematic storytelling and gameplay innovation, will now be developed and published by Xbox. While specific details about the game's narrative and mechanics remain under wraps, casting and performance capture sessions are slated to commence in late 2026. This timeline suggests that the game is still in its relatively early stages of development, allowing ample time for Kojima and his team to craft their signature experience with their new partners.

## A New Chapter for Kojima Productions

The shift from PlayStation to Xbox is a notable one, underscoring the complex relationships between major platform holders and game developers. Kojima, known for his meticulous attention to detail and ambitious scope, will now collaborate with Microsoft to bring **Physint** to life. This partnership could signal a broader trend of cross-platform collaboration or a strategic pivot for Kojima Productions, aiming to leverage the strengths of the Xbox ecosystem. The decision by PlayStation to cancel the project, however, remains a point of intrigue, leaving many to speculate on the reasons behind the divergence.

## Beyond Physint: A Multiverse of Projects

Kojima's creative output extends far beyond **Physint**. Fans can also look forward to an animated film adaptation of **Death Stranding**, tentatively titled **Death Stranding Mosquito**, also expected in 2026. This project will introduce a new character and explore a different facet of the **Death Stranding** universe, distinct from Sam Porter Bridges' journey. Furthermore, Kojima has revealed that the concept for **Death Stranding 3** has already been written, though he expresses a desire for another creator to helm its development. Meanwhile, the live-action **Death Stranding** film, produced by A24 and directed by **Michael Sernowski**, is also progressing, promising to expand the franchise's narrative horizons into new mediums.

## What's Next

With **Physint** targeting a late 2026 commencement for its intensive development phases, and the **Death Stranding** animated film also slated for 2026, the coming years promise a wealth of new content from **Hideo Kojima**. Fans will be eagerly awaiting further announcements regarding casting for **Physint** and more concrete details on the release windows for these ambitious projects.
